body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-13 19:50Z): TermAl restricts this session's verification credit while any background/orphaned Claude work (e.g. my run_in_background mail-guard loops) is running without a verified end. The X'' Windows leg (test-11e05b69) still landed with Engram state "received" (record 850ed5db), but to be safe, before starting a registered credited test from this session, stop or let finish all background guard loops and do not start new ones until the test ENDs; then re-arm the guard. Also: never let a background loop both read AND acknowledge mail; read bodies in the foreground before acknowledging (a background read+ack nearly hid Engram::Opus #1109).
